proof_body:
by
  intro R K _ _ _ _ _ _ t ht x hx
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := R) x
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hx
  obtain ⟨m, u, rfl⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible ha0 ht
  obtain ⟨k, v, rfl⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible hb0 ht
  have inj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R K) := IsFractionRing.injective R K
  have ht0 : algebraMap R K t ≠ 0 := fun h => ht.ne_zero (inj (by simpa using h))
  have hv0 : algebraMap R K (v : R) ≠ 0 := fun h => v.ne_zero (inj (by simpa using h))
  refine ⟨u * v⁻¹, (m : ℤ) - k, ?_⟩
  have hvinv : algebraMap R K ((v⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) = (algebraMap R K (v : R))⁻¹ := by
    apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
    rw [← map_mul, Units.inv_mul, map_one]
  rw [Units.val_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hvinv, zpow_sub₀ ht0, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (R K : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (t : R), Irreducible t → ∀ x : K, x ≠ 0 → ∃ (u : Rˣ) (n : ℤ), x = algebraMap R K u * (algebraMap R K t) ^ n
